purpose: Paperclip hermes_local MiniMax M3 adapter proof. Records the bounded test-agent contract (consumed from M014-S05-minimax-provider-contract.json paperclip_minimax_profile_shape) and the live execution POSTURE for a clean Paperclip hermes_local session that invokes the upgraded hermes-agent runtime against the MiniMax M3 endpoint through the Paperclip adapter. In the auto-mode execution lane, T04 CANNOT open an authenticated SSH session to the live VPS (T02 phase_verdict=PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED; T03 prerequisite_state_for_T03.gate_satisfied=false; LFP-LF-02 forbids unattended live mutation; S02 H-INCONCLUSIVE blocks VPS readback). Therefore this artifact records an HONEST PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED verdict with explicit per-step live_execution_status markers and live_execution_blockers, mirroring T02/T03 fail-closed pattern.
phase_verdict_rationale: T04 in the auto-mode execution lane can produce the Paperclip adapter CONTRACT (bounded test-agent selection, adapter config diff, pre-adapter cleanup plan, restart-clean-not-switch posture, post-adapter validation requirements, xiaomi endpoint reuse detection) but cannot OPEN AN AUTHENTICATED SSH SESSION TO THE LIVE VPS to actually mutate Paperclip adapterConfig.hermesLocal and run the test agent through Paperclip hermes_local. T02 phase_verdict is still PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED (upgrade wheel not installed, 6/6 pre-flight checks not passed, 4/4 patch reconciliations not completed); T03 phase_verdict is still PLAN_READY_LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED (prerequisite_state_for_T03.gate_satisfied=false, 3/3 PDC-* pre-direct cleanup checks pending, direct run fields null); LFP-LF-02 forbids unattended live mutation; LFP-S02-01 forbids destructive recovery; LFP-S02-02 restricts Paperclip restarts to the safe_restart_command only. Producing a fake 'PASS' verdict here would constitute evidence laundering — instead, T04 records PLAN_READY + LIVE_EXECUTION_DEFERRED so the slice can later promote the verdict once an operator-confirmed live Paperclip hermes_local session has succeeded.
